review.brief: Review the diff d16b3d0..HEAD (7 files under internal/charging/ + the change folder) for RM31-charging-add-session-read-ports, tier 2 of roadmap RM31. Validate, as blockers unless noted: (1) module-boundary compliance -- zero files touched outside internal/charging/ and the change folder; charging imports no other module; no HTML/templates. (2) D8 (owner design call): SessionReader must be UNCHANGED at its original single method (ListSessionsByVehicleBetween); the two new methods must live on a new SuperchargerSessionAnalyticsReader that EMBEDS SessionReader, with NewSuperchargerSessionAnalyticsReader alongside an unchanged NewSessionReader. A widened SessionReader is a blocker -- internal/gateway/handlers' fakeSessionReader depends on the narrow shape. (3) D2/D1 no new DB object: no migration, no new index, no altered table/column/constraint; both queries must be served by the existing idx_charge_sessions_vehicle_stop. Any new DB object is a blocker (database is a built-in design gate). (4) query.sql matches design.md Query 1 and Query 2 verbatim in shape; generated query.sql.go is the product of `make sqlc`, not hand-edited. (5) D3 sort direction: ListSessionsByVehicle orders DESC by charge_stop_date_time (backward index scan), deliberately unlike ListSessionsByVehicleBetween's ASC -- and the doc comment says why. (6) D4 nullable tesla_id: both methods use the existing nullable-equality pattern; a NULL-TeslaID row can never be returned by a vehicle-scoped read, and the doc comments say so. Both methods return a non-nil empty slice on no match. (7) D5/D6 reuse: rowToSession, teslaIDToPgInt8 and defaultLimit reused unchanged; both methods on the existing sessionReader in session_reader.go -- no new file, no duplicated helper. (8) TEST CONTRACT -- the highest-value check. design.md authored the expected values BEFORE implementation (section 'Test Contract', T1-T7 for UpdatedSince, T8-T14 + T-Order2 for ByVehicle). Read the two new integration test files against that section and confirm each test asserts the value design.md specified, NOT whatever the implementation happens to produce. A test whose expectation was reverse-engineered from the code is a blocker finding. Confirm T-Order2 still runs its EXPLAIN under `SET LOCAL enable_seqscan = off` (leader decision D2 in progress.json: without it a 4-row fixture makes the planner choose Seq Scan and the assertion would fail a CORRECT design) -- removing that SET is a blocker. (9) spec delta coverage: specs/charge-session-log/spec.md covers both new methods; tasks.md checkboxes all ticked. (10) AGENTS.md documents the SessionReader / SuperchargerSessionAnalyticsReader split and lists both new test files. (11) go-conventions: unit suffixes on unit-bearing fields, km/C/PSI display units, account-scoping on every query. (12) Performance-Profile compliance (read-heavy -- see below). (13) anti-gaming: no acceptance criterion weakened or deleted, no task self-approved, tasks.md append-only.
